slug: 2026-02-11 Revenue Services Lesotho and Standard Lesotho Bank launch e-payment integration for taxes

facts.fact: Revenue Services Lesotho and Standard Lesotho Bank launched on 11 February 2026 an integrated e-payment system letting taxpayers pay taxes electronically by USSD, internet banking and the bank's mobile app.
Revenue Services Lesotho says individuals and businesses can pay Corporate Income Tax, PAYE, VAT and customs duties electronically through the new RSL-SLB e-payment system.

systems.platform: USSD, internet banking, Standard Lesotho Bank mobile app
systems.owner: Revenue Services Lesotho with Standard Lesotho Bank
